summary: States that since Ansible 2.14, meta tasks can be used and notified as handlers, except `flush_handlers`.
questions: Can a handler be a meta task?
Can I use flush_handlers as a handler?

answer_card.title: Meta tasks as handlers
answer_card.answer_md: Since Ansible 2.14, meta tasks can be defined and notified as handlers. The exception is `flush_handlers`, which can't be used as a handler to prevent unexpected behavior.
